meaning:
1) straight in front, be in front of, straight, right, straightness
1a) true things (of prophecy)
1b) rectitude (subst)

elsewhere.note: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.
“Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says Yahweh, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”
